source_verification: Every source/test byte matched the fixed Git tree blob SHA-1 and declared size before execution.
scope: Isolated temporary fixtures and loopback ports. Production port, processes, ledger and network settings were not changed.
verified: The previously failing closed-port/TIME_WAIT test now passes on actual Windows sockets; a real listening port is still rejected.
A genuine unknown timeout is rejected, not treated as an empty port.
At most four artifact reads overlap; no request is exposed before all required verified bytes arrive.
Partial downloads resume without downloading saved files again.
Longest concurrent rate-limit deadline remains durable.
Safe GET disconnection retries preserve TLS verification; writes and certificate errors do not retry.
Immutable source tree caching survives publications and remains bounded.
Fair rotation, receipt invalidation, signed snapshots and candidate failure rollback remain covered.
limitations: Tests do not claim measured production throughput, new-release deployment or OS login-trigger execution. Those require separate observations.
